selectionEntries.comment:
ATTACHMENT REV3: base attachment is Possessed. Daemonkin's copy-cost exemption is active for the attached Possessed host. Daemonic Jump Pack will replace the base host with Warp Talons during the loadout pass.
DAEMONKIN ACC REV4: New Recruit does not reliably expose roster-scope association counts to the separate Additional Copy Costs configuration entry. Until Daemonic Jump Pack is implemented, every Master of Possession is required to attach to Possessed, so the ACC exemption is calculated from Master of Possession selection count instead. The refund ladder is capped by the actual number of excess Possessed copies, preventing over-refunds.
LOADOUT REV5: fixed Bolt Pistol + Sorcerer Weapon with optional Daemonic Jump Pack +20. Daemonkin follows the attachment mode: normal Masters of Possession exempt Possessed from normal copy-cost counting; Daemonic Jump Pack Masters exempt Warp Talons instead.

catalogue.comment:
LAYER 0.1 — LEGIONS AND UNIT SELECTION
Built the Chaos Space Marines roster foundation from the Universal Unit Skeleton and PDF before any loadout work. Legion is a required Configuration selector with Black Legion, Iron Warriors, Night Lords, and Alpha Legion; Black Legion is the default. Legion-exclusive units use safe-hide presentation and constructive wrong-Legion errors. The generic Chaos Lord and Terminator Chaos Lord are intentionally compiled as four Legion-specific player-facing units each, all preserving their shared source profile/cost while carrying the exact Chaos Lord abilities of the selected Legion. Terminator Warsmith also receives the Iron Warriors Chaos Lord abilities because its source profile has Champion of Chaos. All native unit names, minimum legal points costs, Leader/Troop/Other, Rare, Infantry/Vehicle/Monster, Leader Capacity, and ACC semantics are present. Attachments and all loadout/configuration details are intentionally deferred to later passes.

LAYER 0.2 — LEGION PRESENTATION REV2
Retargeted to Game System Rev15. Legion-specific units now use their Legion as the primary Army List presentation category: Black Legion, Iron Warriors, Night Lords, or Alpha Legion. Their original Leader/Other and Infantry/Vehicle/Rare/counting categories remain attached as secondary semantic tags. Generic Chaos Space Marines units remain under Leader, Troop, and Other. Legion visibility, safe-hide behavior, constructive wrong-Legion errors, ACC, and points are unchanged.

LAYER 0.3 — ARMY-LEVEL RULES REV3
Completed the non-loadout army-construction pass. Added required Leader attachments for all four Legion-specific Chaos Lords, Chaos Sorcerer, Master of Possession, and Chaos Apothecary, with constructive missing-host errors and one-external-Leader-per-host validation. Chaos Lord Glorious Jump Pack and Master of Possession Daemonic Jump Pack attachment overrides remain intentionally deferred until those paid loadout options exist. Replenished Ranks now sets the attached Legionaries root cost to 0; paid descendant costs will inherit the same association-aware zeroing during the loadout pass. Daemonkin now exempts the attached Possessed occurrence from normal Additional Copy Cost counting through association-aware surcharge refunds. Rare, Leader/Troop/Other, Infantry/Vehicle/Monster, Leader Capacity, Legion presentation, Legion availability, and normal ACC semantics were re-audited against the UUS.

REV4 — DAEMONKIN ACC RUNTIME FIX
Replaced the unproven roster-scope association-count query used by Daemonkin with a selection-count refund ladder. In this pre-loadout layer every Master of Possession must attach to Possessed, so each Master of Possession represents one exempt Possessed occurrence. The refund is capped by the number of copies that would otherwise incur Additional Copy Costs. Daemonic Jump Pack will require this exemption trigger to be refined when that option is implemented.

LAYER 0.4 — CHAOS LORDS / MASTER OF POSSESSION LOADOUTS REV5
Implemented loadouts for all four non-Terminator Legion Chaos Lords and Master of Possession. Chaos Lords use singular Lightning Claw in both mandatory weapon lists instead of a separate Lightning Claws replacement state. Glorious Jump Pack +20 and Daemonic Jump Pack +20 now switch required attachment targets to Raptors and Warp Talons respectively. Daemonkin is mode-aware: normal Masters of Possession exempt Possessed from Additional Copy Costs; Daemonic Jump Pack Masters exempt Warp Talons.

LAYER 0.5 — OLYMPIAN ARMOURY LEGIONARIES REV6
Added Iron Warriors-only Olympian Armoury Legionaries. The customizable fifth model appears first as Champion / Special Weapon / Heavy Weapon / Butcher. The remaining four models export as separate 4x Shrapnel Boltgun and 4x Combat Knife lines. Added Counts As: Legionaries to both Legionaries variants. Olympian Armoury Legionaries inherit Legionaries attachment eligibility, paid wargear, one-Leader host validation, and full Replenished Ranks zero-cost behavior.

REV7 — OLYMPIAN ROLE LABEL CLEANUP
Suppressed the redundant 'Champion / Special Weapon / Heavy Weapon / Butcher' wrapper label on Olympian Armoury Legionaries. The mandatory one-of-four role selector remains unchanged and now presents directly as Champion / Special Weapon Legionary / Heavy Weapon Legionary / Butcher Legionary.

LAYER 0.6 — IRON WARRIORS LOADOUTS / RULE CLEANUP REV8
Added complete loadouts for Tyrant Siege Terminators and Iron Circle Automata. Tyrant Siege Terminators are represented as two explicit models, each with separate Combi-Bolter and Tyrant Rocket Launcher lines and an independent Power Fist / Chainfist choice. Iron Circle Automata uses separate fixed lines for Olympia Bolt Cannon, Graviton Maul, and Kaceri Battle Shield. Removed non-attachment root rules from all Legion Chaos Lords, all Legion Terminator Chaos Lords, and Terminator Warsmith. Non-Terminator Chaos Lords retain only Leader Attachment at root; attachment-related paid Jump Pack rules remain on their paid options.

LAYER 0.7 — NEMESIS CLAW REV9
Implemented the full Nemesis Claw loadout with Visionary, one shared two-model default-loadout decision, and two explicit specialist models. The specialist models each choose Special Weapon, Heavy Weapon, or Nemesis Claw Butcher. Butcher options are Nostraman Chainglaive, Weird Claws, and Sorcerous Totem.
